t: Easyfix galvanised extra large head clout nails are durable roofing nails designed for secure fastening of roofing materials. With a galvanised finish, these 3mm x 30mm nails offer exceptional corrosion resistance, ensuring long-lasting performance in various weather conditions. They are ideal for professional roofers and builders undertaking projects such as securing roofing felt or shingles on sheds, outbuildings, and larger roofs. The extra large head provides a strong hold, preventing material pull-through and ensuring a reliable, weatherproof finish for both indoor and outdoor applications.
b: Suitable for Both Indoor & Outdoor Use
Approx. 420 Nails Per Pack for Efficiency
